--By SMITHY, Flight Controller --SHORTHAND NOTATIONS m=math tau=m.pi*2 IN=input.getNumber IB=input.getBool ON=output.setNumber
--VECTOR FUNCTIONS vec = function(x,y,z) return {x=x,y=y,z=z} end function vec_add(A,B) return vec(A.x+B.x,A.y+B.y,A.z+B.z) end function vec_mult(A,n) return vec(A.x*n,A.y*n,A.z*n) end function vec_cross(A,B) return vec(A.y*B.z-A.z*B.y,A.z*B.x-A.x*B.z,A.x*B.y-A.y*B.x) end
--SET INITIAL VARIABLES push=false
function onTick() --KINEMATICS --Missile Relative Orthogonal Unit Vectors rx,ry,rz=IN(4),IN(5),IN(6) cx,cy,cz=m.cos(rx),m.cos(ry),m.cos(rz) sx,sy,sz=m.sin(rx),m.sin(ry),m.sin(rz) Xn = vec(cy*cz,cy*sz,-sy) Yn = vec(-cx*sz+sx*sy*cz,cx*cz+sx*sy*sz,sx*cy) Zn = vec_cross(Xn,Yn)
--Missile GPS Positions mpos = vec(IN(1),IN(2),IN(3))
--Look Direction head = vec_mult(vec(IN(17),IN(18),0),tau) distance = m.cos(head.y) head = vec(distance*m.sin(head.x),m.sin(head.y),distance*m.cos(head.x))
radio = vec(IN(19),IN(20),IN(21))
--Target Information send = radio.x~= 0 and radio or vec_add(vec_add(vec_mult(Xn,head.x),vec_mult(Yn,head.y)),vec_mult(Zn,head.z))
--LAUNCH CONTROLLER ON(1,send.x) ON(2,send.y) ON(3,send.z)
end

--By SMITHY, Zero-Effort-Miss Augmented Proportional Navigation --SHORTHAND NOTATIONS m=math tau=m.pi*2 IN=input.getNumber ON=output.setNumber PN=property.getNumber
--INITIAL CONDITIONS Kr=PN("Angular Gain") Ke=PN("Error Gain") P=PN("Missile Profile") R=PN("GPS Search Zone (0=infinite)")
--VECTOR FUNCTIONS vec=function(x,y,z) return {x=x,y=y,z=z} end function vec_add(A,B) return vec(A.x+B.x,A.y+B.y,A.z+B.z) end function vec_sub(A,B) return vec(A.x-B.x,A.y-B.y,A.z-B.z) end function vec_mult(A,n) return vec(A.x*n,A.y*n,A.z*n) end function vec_div(A,n) return vec(A.x/n,A.y/n,A.z/n) end function vec_length(vec) return m.sqrt(vec.x*vec.x+vec.y*vec.y+vec.z*vec.z) end function vec_2Len(vec) return m.sqrt(vec.x*vec.x+vec.y*vec.y) end function vec_dot(A,B) return (A.x*B.x+A.y*B.y+A.z*B.z) end function vec_norm(A) return vec_div(A,vec_length(A)) end function vec_cross(A,B) return vec(A.y*B.z-A.z*B.y,A.z*B.x-A.x*B.z,A.x*B.y-A.y*B.x) end function vec_reject(A,B) return vec_sub(A,vec_mult(B,vec_dot(A,B))) end
--SET INITIAL VARIABLES set=vec(0,0,0) K1,K2 = 12,-4.285 lmvel,ltpos,ltvel,ltacc,radio=set,set,set,set,set tgo=0
function onTick() --KINEMATICS --Missile Relative Orthogonal Unit Vectors rx,ry,rz=IN(4),IN(5),IN(6) cx,cy,cz=m.cos(rx),m.cos(ry),m.cos(rz) sx,sy,sz=m.sin(rx),m.sin(ry),m.sin(rz) Xn = vec(cy*cz,cy*sz,-sy) Yn = vec(-cx*sz+sx*sy*cz,cx*cz+sx*sy*sz,sx*cy) Zn = vec_cross(Xn,Yn)
--Missile Kinematics mpos = vec(IN(1),IN(2),IN(3)) mvel = vec(IN(7),IN(8),IN(9)) mvel = vec_add(vec_add(vec_mult(Xn,mvel.x),vec_mult(Yn,mvel.y)),vec_mult(Zn,mvel.z)) macc = vec_mult(vec_sub(mvel,lmvel),60)
--Target Position radar = vec(IN(18)*tau,IN(20),IN(19)*tau) hlen = radar.y*m.cos(radar.z)
tpos = vec(m.sin(radar.x)*hlen,m.sin(radar.z)*radar.y,m.cos(radar.x)*hlen) tpos = vec_add(vec_add(vec_add(vec_mult(Xn,tpos.x),vec_mult(Yn,tpos.y)),vec_mult(Zn,tpos.z)),mpos)
radio1 = vec(IN(21),IN(22),IN(23)) radio = vec_length(radio1)~=0 and radio1 or radio
--Missile Angular Vector angular = vec(IN(10),IN(11),IN(12)) angular = vec(vec_dot(angular,Yn),-vec_dot(angular,Xn),0)
if strength or vec_length(radio)>1.1 then if radio.x~=0 then if not strength then tpos = radio
elseif vec_length(vec_sub(radio,tpos))>R and R~=0 then tpos = radio
end end
--Target Velocity and Acceleration tvel = vec_mult(vec_sub(tpos,ltpos),60) tacc = vec_mult(vec_sub(tvel,ltvel),60) tjerk = vec_mult(vec_sub(tacc,ltacc),60)
--Missile-Target Relative Positions range = vec_sub(tpos,mpos)
--Missile-Target Relative Velocity and Acceleration rvel = vec_sub(tvel,mvel) racc = vec_sub(tacc,macc)
--Time-to-Go Estimations tgo = P==1 and vec_length(range)/vec_length(vec_add(vec_mult(racc,tgo*0.5),rvel)) or m.abs(vec_length(range)/vec_length(rvel))
--MISSILE GUIDANCE LAW --Zero-Effort-Miss Augmented Proportional Navigation ZEM = vec_add(vec_add(range,vec_mult(rvel,tgo)),vec_mult(tacc,m.min(0.5*tgo*tgo,0.5))) if P==1 then acmd = vec_mult(ZEM,5.39/(tgo*tgo))
else ZEM = vec_add(vec_mult(ZEM,K1),vec_mult(vec_sub(vec(0,-1,0),vec_norm(mvel)),K2*vec_length(mvel)*tgo)) acmd = vec_mult(ZEM,3/(tgo*tgo))
end acmd = vec_mult(vec_norm(acmd),m.min(vec_length(acmd),1900))
ltpos = tpos ltvel = tvel ltacc = tacc
else acmd = vec_mult(radio,350*m.max(48-vec_length(mvel)/12,2)) tgo = 0
end
--FLIGHT CONTROL SYSTEM --Calculate Acceleration Error error = vec_sub(vec_reject(acmd,vec_norm(mvel)),macc) error = vec(vec_dot(error,Xn),vec_dot(error,Yn),0)
cmd = vec_sub(vec_mult(error,Ke),vec_mult(angular,Kr))
--Apply Command ON(1,cmd.x)--yaw ON(2,cmd.y-0.117)--pitch
ON(3,target and 0.01+m.abs(radar.x)/tau or 1) ON(4,target and 0.01+m.abs(radar.z)/tau or 1)
strength = IN(24) strength = (strength>0 and vec_length(mvel)>250) and (strength*radar.y>2501 or strength*radar.y<2499)
lmvel = mvel
end
